reward.note: pilot training objective, not a benchmark metric

protocol.termination: the episode ends on a terminal action (finish/escalate/abstain), or after 12 environment steps, whichever comes first; a step-limited episode is recorded as such and kept in the results

training_scenarios.rule: every W2 scenario in the canonical 1.2.0 train partition

validation_scenarios.rule: first scenario id per branch (lexicographic), plus the second escalate_unapproved to balance act against escalate

config.kl_note: No KL/entropy term and no weight decay: with zero regularization every parameter change is attributable to the reward objective alone, which is what this pilot has to be able to claim.
